paragraphs: From Sligo test centre, depart left onto the L3608 and follow it for about 1.7km
At the rotary take the slight left onto Oakfield Road
Exit slight left to stay on Oakfield Road continue onto the on-ramp on the right and merge slight right onto the Collooney to Sligo Dual Carriageway, staying with the flow of traffic
Leaving the dual carriageway, head onto Ray MacSharry Road at the rotary going straight
Exit straight to stay on Ray MacSharry Road take the next left onto Magheraboy Road and continue along it
At the roundabout turn right onto Larkhill Road and follow it through the residential area
Take the 1st right onto Knappagh Road, then the 1st right again into The Park Avenue
Perform a controlled U-turn on The Park Avenue when it is safe, checking mirrors and blind spots carefully
At the end of the road turn right back onto Knappagh Road
Take the next right onto Wolfe Tone Street left onto Upper John Street, followed by a right onto Temple Street
Turn right onto Gallows Hill continue straight as the road becomes Newtownholmes Road
At the rotary take the left exit onto Crozon Park and exit left to stay on it
At the end of the road turn right onto Circular Road
Right again onto Pearse Road at the roundabout
Take the slight left exit onto the N4 continue to the Carrowroe Roundabout and go straight through, following the unnamed road as it continues
As the route loops back toward Sligo test centre, arrive on the right at the L3608 and continue along it
Perform a U-turn where directed turn left onto the L3608
At the rotary take the slight left onto Oakfield Road and follow it back, arriving on the right at Oakfield Road near the centre
